newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT-Eagle Mining rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT-Eagle Mining rated buy.

text.p: Brokerage house J.B. Were and Son has rated Western Australian-based Eagle Mining Corp NL as a buy, citing a possible upgrade of reserves at the small gold miner's Nimary mine and an attractive price-earnings multiple.

The report, dated September and prepared before Eagle announced on Tuesday a big turnaround in annual earnings, also said the company was one of Australia's lowest-cost producers and was run by a growth-orientated management team.
The Nimary mine, commissioned last December, is estimated to have a total resource of 940,000 ounces.
But Eagle chief executive Tony Poli said on Tuesday, after announcing a net profit of A$7 million for the year to June 30, that the deposit could yield more than one million ounces.
The J.B. Were report appeared to agree. "Initial mining suggested a large under-estimation of contained ounces," it said.
Eagle's share price stood at A$2.80 at 0035 GMT, level with Tuesday's closing price.
The report, by J.B. Were analysts Robin Widdup and Tim Churcher, was based on a share price of A$2.90.
At this level, the analysts said Eagle offered a relatively low premium to net asset value and an attractive price-earnings multiple of 10 to 12 times.
